title: v1.6.0 — Life Goal Milestones and Step-Level Phase Tracking
changelog: Key Milestones Tracking Mode: Track life goals through sequentially defined, high-impact milestones with target dates and descriptions
Inline Milestone Management: Add, edit, check off, and delete milestones directly from the goal card and goal editor
Step-Level Phase & Roadmap Tracking: Progress in roadmap/phases mode is now measured and recalculated per individual step inside phases rather than only at the whole-phase level
Step Progress Visualization: Live step counters and mini progress bars inside roadmap phases for immediate visual feedback
Rich Audit Trail: Automatically logs milestone achievements and step completions into the goal progress history with 1-tap undo capability
